name: slingr-mcp
description: Connect any Slingr App to MCP-compatible AI clients.
long_description: Slingr MCP dynamically reads a Slingr App's OpenAPI documentation, normalizes Slingr-specific API definitions, and exposes the available API operations as MCP tools.

app_url.description: Base URL of the Slingr App API.

openapi_url.description: URL of the Slingr App OpenAPI documentation.
